platforms.name: LeetCode
platforms.bestFor: Timed DSA practice, company-tagged mediums, and contest pressure.

platforms.name: Pramp
platforms.bestFor: Free peer mock interviews with structured feedback rotations.

platforms.name: interviewing.io
platforms.bestFor: Anonymous mocks with experienced engineers and detailed rubrics.

platforms.name: Exponent
platforms.bestFor: System design and behavioral courses with sample interview videos.

platforms.name: Hello Interview
platforms.bestFor: Structured system design frameworks and mock interviews.

platforms.name: NeetCode
platforms.bestFor: Pattern-organized problem lists and video explanations after your attempt.

platforms.name: CodeSignal
platforms.bestFor: Proctored-style coding assessments and arcade practice modes.

items.title: Daily retention: arrays & hash map
items.instructions: Solve Two Sum and Valid Anagram timed (12 min each). Attempt without AI; review NeetCode only after both submissions.
coverChecklist: Run at least two custom tests

items.title: Weekly mock: foundations coding set
items.instructions: Saturday mock: 2 problems in 70 minutes (35 each), 20 min retro. Problems: Contains Duplicate II (medium) and Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock (easy). No AI during mock.
coverChecklist: Write retro: time lost, bug class

items.title: Daily retention: two pointers
items.instructions: 15 min: Valid Palindrome. 15 min: 3Sum (outline approach if stuck 5 min, then attempt). AI only after session.

items.title: Go daily: maps and table tests
items.instructions: Implement group anagrams logic in Go with table-driven tests. Attempt without AI first.

items.title: Daily retention: sliding window
items.instructions: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters in 25 min; 10 min complexity recap aloud.

items.title: Fundamentals check: OS processes
items.instructions: Answer fund001–fund003 self-check questions in writing without notes; grade yourself honestly.

items.title: Weekly mock: stacks & queues
items.instructions: Saturday: Valid Parentheses (15 min) + Daily Temperatures (35 min) + 20 min retro. Simulate interviewer silence.

items.title: Communication daily: coding opener
items.instructions: Record com001 practice prompt once; listen back for filler words. No AI script.

items.title: Daily retention: binary search
items.instructions: Search Insert Position and Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array (attempt both). Review only after.

items.title: Go daily: goroutines intro
items.instructions: Complete go011 practice prompt; run with -race. Attempt without AI first.

items.title: Networking daily: DNS trace
items.instructions: Answer net001 checklist from memory; run dig +trace on a domain locally and compare to your trace.

items.title: Weekly mock: trees
items.instructions: Saturday mock: Invert Binary Tree (10 min warm-up) + Binary Tree Level Order Traversal (30 min) + Lowest Common Ancestor of BST (35 min).

items.title: Daily retention: BFS template
items.instructions: Number of Islands in 25 min; 10 min rewrite BFS from scratch on blank editor.

items.title: System design read: URL shortener
items.instructions: Attempt sd009 practice prompt fully before watching any video. Then skim Hello Interview outline for gaps only.

items.title: Go daily: HTTP middleware
items.instructions: Build go026 middleware chain with httptest coverage. No AI until tests written.

items.title: Weekly mock: graphs onsite pair
items.instructions: Saturday: Course Schedule (25 min) + Word Ladder (45 min) + 30 min retro. Optional: schedule Pramp peer session same weekend.

items.title: Fundamentals daily: ACID & isolation
items.instructions: Write answers to fund009 and fund010 self-check questions; relate to Go go030 transaction exercise.

items.title: Daily retention: heap
items.instructions: Kth Largest Element in Array (heap) and Merge K Sorted Lists. Attempt without AI.

items.title: Networking daily: TLS & timeouts
items.instructions: Explain net005 and net011 checklists in a 5-minute recording. Attempt solo first.

items.title: Weekly mock: mixed mediums
items.instructions: Saturday LeetCode weekly contest or self-scheduled: any two mediums you have not solved. Strict 45+45 timing.

items.title: System design mock: rate limiter
items.instructions: 45-minute timed sd010 HLD on paper; then 15 min compare to notes. No AI during timer.

items.title: Daily retention: backtracking intro
items.instructions: Subsets and Combination Sum I with explicit state tree sketch on paper first.

items.title: Go daily: context & shutdown
items.instructions: Combine go014 and go028 into a small server that cancels work on shutdown. Attempt without AI.
coverChecklist: In-flight request completes or aborts cleanly

items.title: Weekly mock: peer coding
items.instructions: Book Pramp or interviewing.io session; solve one medium with full communication scoring.

items.title: Daily retention: trie
items.instructions: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree) from scratch in preferred language; 30 min cap.

items.title: STAR story draft
items.instructions: Complete com008 and com010 written drafts. Attempt without AI; polish once.

items.title: System design: news feed
items.instructions: Full sd011 session with fan-out math. Record audio. Review without AI first pass on rubric.

items.title: Weekly mock: DP fundamentals
items.instructions: Saturday: Climbing Stairs (warm-up) + House Robber + Longest Increasing Subsequence (n log n if ready).

items.title: Daily retention: union find
items.instructions: Number of Connected Components and Redundant Connection. Implement DSU once reusable.

items.title: Go daily: SQL transactions
items.instructions: Implement go030 transfer exercise with sqlite in-memory. Attempt without AI.

items.title: Weekly mock: Google-ish set
items.instructions: Pick two Google-tagged LeetCode mediums you have not seen; 50 min each with break. Full think-aloud.

items.title: CodeSignal arcade sprint
items.instructions: Complete 3 CodeSignal arcade tasks focusing on clean implementation speed.

items.title: System design: chat
items.instructions: sd012 with WebSocket scaling focus. Draw sequence diagram send message → deliver.

items.title: Networking mock trace
items.instructions: Deliver net025 90-second trace for your own project's API. Attempt without slides.

items.title: LLD daily: LRU cache
items.instructions: sd019 timed implementation. Go or Java. No AI until 25 minutes elapsed.

items.title: Weekly mock: behavioral + coding
items.instructions: 30 min behavioral (com013–com016) recorded answers; 60 min one hard LeetCode attempt.

items.title: Daily retention: intervals
items.instructions: Merge Intervals and Non-overlapping Intervals back-to-back.

items.title: Go capstone: mini service
items.instructions: Weekend build: HTTP API with middleware, slog, sqlite, Docker per go032–go034. Attempt without AI codegen.

items.title: System design: notifications
items.instructions: sd013 full pass with idempotency and DLQ. Compare to checklist only after.

items.title: Weekly mock: onsite simulation
items.instructions: Saturday onsite sim: 2 coding (45+45), 1 system design (45), 2 behavioral (20 each). Breaks 10 min between. No AI.

items.title: Weak area sprint assessment
items.instructions: From prior mocks, pick weakest tag; solve 3 problems of that tag timed easy→medium→medium.

items.title: System design: autocomplete
items.instructions: sd015 with latency budget p99 < 100ms. Attempt solo; then watch one Exponent clip for missing pieces only.

items.title: Polish: light retention set
items.instructions: Two problems you solved before—must re-code from memory without hints. Focus fluency not new patterns.

items.title: Final weekly mock: confidence calibration
items.instructions: Final Saturday mock: one fresh medium, one design you know well (15 min recap only), one behavioral. Rest Sunday.
